name: fstack
description: Founder's Stack. Answer leads, close support loops, and ship product without slop.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to users. Build the thing
interface.longDescription: fstack is a dual-engine skill stack for founders who still write the product. One router classifies the request: founder operations (inbound leads, support, social, strategy, competitive teardown) or engineering (/engineer-mode with 23 playbooks and 25 principles). The bridge skill is /support-loop: diagnose the customer issue, fix the bug with a failing test, and draft the reply you can send.
defaultPrompt: Reply to this inbound lead honestly.
